services:
  modernuo:
    build:
      context: ../..
      dockerfile: docker/uo/Dockerfile
      args:
        DOTNET_VERSION: "10.0.203"
        MODERNUO_COMMIT: "7c9215d97"
    container_name: sl-modernuo
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "2593:2593"
      - "2593:2593/udp"
    volumes:
      # Canonical custom scripts, synced into the container on each start
      - ${SERVER_PATH}/customizations:/modernuo-projects:ro
      # Server configuration (modernuo.json, etc.)
      - ${SERVER_PATH}/uo/modernuo/Configuration:/modernuo/Configuration
      # World saves
      - ${SERVER_PATH}/lib/uo/modernuo/Saves:/var/lib/uo/modernuo/Saves
      # Backups & archives written by ModernUO
      - ${SERVER_PATH}/lib/uo/modernuo/Backups:/var/lib/uo/modernuo/Backups
      - ${SERVER_PATH}/lib/uo/modernuo/Archives:/var/lib/uo/modernuo/Archives
      # UO client data (maps, art, tiledata, etc.)
      - ${CLIENT_DATA_PATH}:/var/lib/uo/client-data/classic-client:ro
    environment:
      TZ: ${TZ:-America/Chicago}
    stdin_open: true   # allows: docker attach sl-modernuo
    tty: true
    security_opt:
      - seccomp:unconfined   # io_uring requires relaxed seccomp (WSL2/Docker Desktop)

  ddns-updater:
    image: qmcgaw/ddns-updater:latest
    container_name: sl-ddns
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - ddns_data:/updater/data
    environment:
      CONFIG: |
        {
          "settings": [
            {
              "provider": "cloudflare",
              "zone_identifier": "${CF_ZONE_ID}",
              "domain": "${DOMAIN}",
              "host": "@",
              "ttl": 120,
              "token": "${CF_API_TOKEN}",
              "ip_version": "ipv4"
            }
          ]
        }
      PERIOD: 5m
      UPDATE_COOLDOWN_PERIOD: 5m
      PUBLICIP_FETCHERS: all
      # Look our own records up on public DNS. The home router answers with the LAN address
      # (split DNS), which made the health check fail and the record rewrite every period (bug D23).
      RESOLVER_ADDRESS: "1.1.1.1:53"
      LOG_LEVEL: info

volumes:
  ddns_data:
